registry.description: Standards registry & mapping documents (no code change)

infrastructure.description: Schema, CI gate, kanban CLI, JSON Schema validators

implementation.description: Code that enacts a specific standard (#109-130 + selected external)

governance.description: Agent declarations, audit events, evidence bundles, compliance posture

cards.title: Standards registry (130 rows)
cards.acceptance: docs/standards/registry.json exists, parses, contains 130 rows with status/owner/evidence fields populated. Total + by_status + by_domain summaries match.

cards.title: Per-domain mapping docs (security, identity, quality, ssd, supply-chain, policy, observability)
cards.acceptance: Each standards mapping doc covers every standard in its domain with applicability, status, gap, next-step file path, traceability table.

cards.title: Per-domain mapping docs (ai, platform, ci, performance, platform-build, innovation)
cards.acceptance: Six additional mapping docs covering ai, platform (22 standards), ci, performance, platform-build, innovation.

cards.title: JSON Schema 2020-12 conformance suite
cards.acceptance: internal/standards/standards.go loads and validates documents against action-manifest, evidence-bundle, runner-identity, failure-classification, workflow-provenance. Negative tests confirm invalid docs are rejected.

cards.title: works-standards CLI
cards.acceptance: cmd/works-standards/main.go supports list/show/validate/gaps/summary. `make standards` runs the full gate.

cards.title: works-kanban CLI + kanban board
cards.acceptance: cmd/works-kanban supports summary/lane/card/move/validate. internal/kanban/kanban.go enforces invariants. docs/kanban/board.json is the audit trail.

cards.title: Agent capability declaration: works-worker
cards.acceptance: docs/agents/worker.md declares identity, purpose, owner, model, capabilities, tools, permissions, authority, risk class, allowed/prohibited actions, escalation, human-approval requirements, memory scope, evidence requirements, evaluation criteria, termination conditions for the slice-1+2 works-worker.

cards.title: AI/agent glossary
cards.acceptance: docs/agents/glossary.md defines Action, Artifact, Attempt, Capability manifest, Evidence, Evidence bundle, Lease, Node, Readiness, Work, Worker.

cards.title: Action Capability Manifest admission (#110)
cards.acceptance: services/api/admission.go validates incoming works against the action-manifest schema before persistence. Reject 400 with field-level errors. Add tests in tests/api/admission_test.go.

cards.title: Runner Identity SPIFFE format (#121)
cards.acceptance: Workers mint spiffe://works-execution/ns/<tenant>/sa/<worker-id> at enrollment. Identity validated by services/api/auth.go. Add tests in tests/identity/.

cards.title: Zero-Secret worker enrollment (#114)
cards.acceptance: Replace static WORKS_API auth with OIDC token exchange (or dev-mode SPIFFE-signed enrollment token). Reject static API keys. Add tests in tests/auth/.

cards.title: Hermetic Execution default (#111)
cards.acceptance: Subprocess sandbox applies default-deny: network=deny, secrets=none, FS=isolated, permissions=minimal. Override requires explicit capability manifest entry. Add tests in tests/hermetic/.

cards.title: Workflow Provenance attestation (#122)
cards.acceptance: services/provenance/ produces SLSA-style provenance per work matching the workflow-provenance.schema.json. Exposed via GET /v1/works/{id}/provenance. Signed. Tests in tests/provenance/.

cards.title: Evidence Bundle endpoint (#113, #124)
cards.acceptance: services/evidence/ produces signed JSON bundle matching evidence-bundle.schema.json. Exposed via GET /v1/works/{id}/evidence. Tests in tests/evidence/.

cards.title: Self-Healing failure classifier (#117)
cards.acceptance: services/classifier/ classifies each failure into the 10 categories from failure-classification.schema.json. Per-class retry policy + autonomous remediation set enforced. Tests in tests/classifier/.

cards.title: OpenTelemetry observability (#54, #65, #66)
cards.acceptance: services/observability/ exports W3C trace context + Prometheus metrics at /metrics. 32 metrics from the pack mapped per observability.md. Tests in tests/observability/.

cards.title: Capability-aware scheduler (#116, #118)
cards.acceptance: internal/scheduler/ scores eligible workers on cache locality + cost + queue + trust; explainability record per assignment. Tests in tests/scheduler/.

cards.title: SBOM + CycloneDX emission (#59, #61)
cards.acceptance: ci/local-runner/sbom.sh emits SPDX 3.0 + CycloneDX 1.6 per release. Stored under artifacts/sbom/. Tests in tests/supply_chain/sbom_test.go.

cards.title: OPA policy bundle (#96, #97)
cards.acceptance: First Rego bundle (e.g. lease_grant.rego) enforces a non-trivial rule at the API. Bundle evaluated by services/api/policy.go. Tests in tests/policy/.

cards.title: CloudEvents audit stream (#77, #67)
cards.acceptance: Every Work state transition emits a CloudEvents v1.0 message. Listener at /v1/audit-events. DORA metrics derived (deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, MTTR). Tests in tests/audit/.

cards.title: Slice 1+2 regression gate
cards.acceptance: go test ./... green, go test -tags=e2e green, go test -tags=e2e_chaos green. No regression from slice 3 governance layer.

cards.title: Standards conformance suite
cards.acceptance: internal/standards/standards_test.go covers positive + negative validation for all 5 schemas. 13 tests passing.
